name: textbee Free SMS Gateway
free_limit: Hosted Free plan: 1 active Android device, up to 50 SMS messages/day and 300 SMS messages/month; send/receive SMS and webhook notifications.
watch_out: Requires Android 7+ phone and own SIM/carrier plan; carrier SMS charges and fair-use restrictions apply. Hosted plan is not free SMS infrastructure; commercial eligibility and provider terms should be checked before business use.
